extras: Free and open source; requires initial model download of about 130 MB.
intentEvidence: That is why I built Open Reader: a free, Chinese-friendly, local text-to-speech plugin for Obsidian.
motivation: The author built it because they have ADHD and found that listening helps them re-engage with content when reading becomes difficult.
problem: Users with focus issues, such as ADHD, find it difficult to maintain attention while reading long passages of text.
summary: Local text-to-speech plugin that reads selected text or entire notes aloud using an offline CLI, supporting Chinese and Markdown.
